title: Australian MBO varieties establish themselves in Chile
summary: Reports that Eureka and Twilight are the two most important Mountain Blue varieties in Chile and that the genetics are licensed there through Snackberries.
why_it_matters: Documents the Chilean licensing route for Mountain Blue genetics and identifies Twilight as commercially significant despite its unresolved cultivar identity.

reading.rationale: Short but establishes the Chilean licensing structure.

commercial_position.rationale: Chile is a major southern hemisphere supplier.
